content.text:
I submitted **index 13 (Bi 0.75 / Sb 0.25)**, which had the highest EQE of the three compositions I measured, at 0.0052%. All efficiencies are very low, and with only three measurements across 29 compositions I can't tell whether index 13 is the best in the library.

| Index | Composition (Bi/Sb) | Known phase at that ratio | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 21 | 0.49 / 0.51 | BiSbO4 | 0.0030 |
| 13 | 0.75 / 0.25 | Bi3SbO7 | **0.0052** |
| 5 | 0.92 / 0.08 | Bi2O3-type (XRD) | 0.0015 |

- **Why these three:** the known Bi–Sb oxide phases sit at roughly these ratios, so I measured one from each region.
- **Third measurement:** I spent it on the Bi-rich end. The rise from index 21 to 13 suggested EQE might keep climbing toward Bi, but it fell to 0.0015%, so the pattern peaks somewhere in the middle.
- **XRD:** indices 1 and 5 show nearly the same pattern, closest to Bi2O3 structures (similarity about 0.72). I didn't take XRD at index 13, so I haven't confirmed that its phase is Bi3SbO7.
- **Not measured:** the other compositions near index 13 (about 0.8–0.7 Bi) could be better still, as could anything richer in Sb than index 21.

The merit budget is used up; 3 of the 5 XRD measurements are left unused.
